tool.name: Claude Code
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.
tool.description: Agentic coding tool for terminal, IDE, desktop and web that reads codebases, edits files, runs commands and handles git workflows.
strengths: Runs on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry
tool.licenseWarning: The public GitHub repo is not open source: LICENSE.md is an Anthropic copyright notice that points to the Commercial Terms of Service. No OSI license applies.
tool.pricing: Included in Pro ($20/mo, $17 annual), Max (from $100/mo), Team (standard $25/mo, $20 annual; premium $125/mo, $100 annual) and Enterprise ($20/seat/mo + usage at API rates); or PAYG via API/cloud providers.
tool.practitionerNote: Route through Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform or Microsoft Foundry to keep inference and billing inside an existing cloud estate; enforce managed permissions centrally, since the agent can execute shell commands on developer machines.

dataResidency.detail: Inference region follows the chosen provider (AWS/GCP/Azure regions); Anthropic-direct plans offer US-only inference on Enterprise; local transcripts cached on the developer machine.

deployment.detail: Local client with inference via Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud Agent Platform or Microsoft Foundry; cloud sessions can run in self-hosted environments.

auditLogging.detail: Enterprise audit logs and Compliance API; OpenTelemetry export of prompts (opt-in), tool results and permission decisions; CloudTrail / Cloud Audit Logs / Azure Monitor on cloud providers.

soc2.detail: Anthropic SOC 2 Type I and Type II cover commercial products (Claude for Work, Anthropic API).

iso27001.detail: Anthropic ISO/IEC 27001:2022 covers commercial products (Claude for Work, Anthropic API).

iso42001.detail: Anthropic ISO/IEC 42001:2023 covers commercial products (Claude for Work, Anthropic API).

euAiAct.detail: Assessed limited-risk by product category (general-purpose assistant); no published Anthropic EU AI Act conformity statement for this product.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary tool under Anthropic Commercial Terms; model choice limited to Claude.
